provenance: Bootstrap calibration (CORE stage): scratchpad/finalize_calibration.py, numpy PCG64 seed 20260731, dev split = 12 stratified synthetic speakers rendered by engine/voicebox.py (4-formant regime, jitter/shimmer/breathiness, +-6 dB gain, 20-30 dB white noise, per-utterance F0 sd 2.5%), disjoint from any eval speaker. feature_norms: scale = pooled within-speaker sd / sqrt(clip(F-1, 0.05, 1.0)) (within-class variance normalization damped for dimensions whose between-speaker variance does not exceed their within-speaker variance); mean = population mean - 8.0 * scale, the offset that makes cosine similarity rank by within-class Mahalanobis distance rather than by direction alone. theta_verify = midpoint(p98 dev impostor, p5 dev clean genuine) over 312 impostor and 24 genuine comparisons; theta_enroll = midpoint(max dev mixed-set LOO, min dev pure-set LOO).
